rows.label: EPA per play
rows.definition: Expected points added per play (offense: gained; defense: allowed).

rows.label: Success rate
rows.definition: Share of plays gaining 50% of the yards needed on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd/4th.

rows.label: Explosiveness
rows.definition: Average EPA on successful plays: how big the good plays are.

rows.label: Yards per play
rows.definition: Total yards divided by plays (box score).

rows.label: Pass rate
rows.definition: Share of plays that are passes (offense: called; defense: faced). A style, not a grade.

rows.label: Standard-down success
rows.definition: Success rate on standard downs (1st, 2nd-and-7 or less, 3rd/4th-and-4 or less).

rows.label: Points per opportunity
rows.definition: Points per drive that reaches the opponent's 40 (defense: allowed).

rows.label: Havoc rate
rows.definition: Plays with a tackle for loss, forced fumble, interception or pass breakup (offense: allowed; defense: created).

rows.label: Average starting field position
rows.definition: Yards from the opponent's goal line at the start of a drive (offense: own drives; defense: opponents' drives). Lower is better for an offense.

groups.title: Overall efficiency
groups.why: Overall efficiency is the best single predictor of scoring margin.

groups.why: Passing efficiency drives most of the variance in college scoring.

groups.why: Line, second-level and open-field yards locate where a run game gains or loses.

records.label: Records
records.detail: Completed games in the CFBD schedule, this season

market.label: Market consensus
market.detail: CFBD /lines, every listed book folded into one quote by the Command Center (market.consensus): spread and total averaged across books; moneylines averaged as implied probabilities, then de-vigged proportionally. Implied team totals are (total - spread) / 2 and (total + spread) / 2 from that same quote.

model.label: Rogue projection
model.detail: Rogue Analytics spread-free ensemble (Command Center models.project_games); the market line is never a model input. Projected scores are the projected total split by the projected margin.

advanced.label: Season stats (raw)
advanced.detail: CFBD /stats/season/advanced, season to date, garbage time excluded, not adjusted for opponents

basic.label: Season stats (box score)
basic.detail: CFBD /stats/season, season to date, garbage time included

adjusted.label: Opponent-adjusted
adjusted.detail: Command Center ridge solve over CFBD advanced stats: every team's offense and defense estimated together so each number is net of the opponents faced. This season only; no prior-season blend

direction.label: Passing location / rush direction
direction.detail: CFBD /passing/teams/season and /rushing/teams/season, season to date at the last pull; buckets from the play-by-play charting (short/deep x left/middle/right)

feed.label: Pass-play feed
feed.detail: CFBD /plays/passing, one row per throw (air yards, YAC, target, EPA), season to date, garbage time included, spikes dropped

ratings.label: Ratings
ratings.detail: Elo: CFBD /ratings/elo entering this week. Talent: CFBD /talent (247Sports team talent composite)

conventions.spread: Spreads and margins are the home team's line (away points minus home points): negative means the home team is favored.
conventions.difference: Every difference is Rogue minus the market.
conventions.percentile: Percentiles rank FBS teams, 100th = best; defensive ranks reward allowing less.
conventions.advantage: Advantage = offense percentile minus the opposing defense's percentile, in points (−100 to +100). 25 or more either way is notable, 45 or more strong.

thesis: Rogue's projected margin (Louisiana Tech −0.7) sits within 2.5 points of the consensus (Louisiana Tech −3.0).
Rogue projects 53.0 total points against a consensus of 46.8 (+6.2).
Louisiana's offense holds the edge in opponent-adjusted rush explosiveness: Louisiana offense ranks 29th of 138, Louisiana Tech defense ranks 130th of 138.

takeaways.text: Louisiana's offense holds the edge in opponent-adjusted rush explosiveness: Louisiana offense ranks 29th of 138, Louisiana Tech defense ranks 130th of 138.
Louisiana Tech's defense holds the edge in opponent-adjusted standard-down success: Louisiana offense ranks 109th of 138, Louisiana Tech defense ranks 38th of 138.

Louisiana's run game leans on explosive plays more than down-to-down consistency (rush explosiveness ranks well above its rush success rate).
